channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Prop 4 repeal group alleges Better Boundaries broke election laws by paying for stamps
item.description: The group pushing for the repeal of Utah's ban on gerrymandering says its opposition's effort to convince people to remove their signatures from petitions is against the law.

item.title: Letter: One has to wonder what drives Utah leaders’ incessant quest to target the LGBTQ community
item.description: Letter: If Spencer Cox and Utah legislators in their cruelty are targeting trans people just to score cheap political points, might I suggest they aim at an even more harmless target instead? Like, kicking puppies?

item.title: Letter: In 2024, 79% of Trump voters identified as Christian. Here’s what that suggests.
item.description: Letter: Jesus said to love thy neighbor as thyself. How is it possible so many self-professed “Christians” can support Donald Trump and not struggle with the dissonance?

item.title: Letter: America’s stature as the land of immigrants is being destroyed. It’s time to amend our great symbols and return the Statue of Liberty.
item.description: Letter: The United States should no longer use “E pluribus unum” as our national motto. “Out of many, one”? Clearly we no longer believe that.

item.title: Squatty Potty creator arrested in Utah on charge of buying child sexual abuse material
item.description: The 50-year-old Utah man, Robert "Bobby" Edwards, who co-founded Squatty Potty, has been indicted on a federal charge of receiving images depicting child sexual abuse.

item.title: Here’s one idea from Utah lawmakers to address the state’s housing crunch
item.description: Herriman's mayor says new funding would "unlock thousands of [housing] units in our community” if a proposed law passes.

item.title: Utah A.G. sends first cases to state’s new constitutional court — and already the panel faces a lawsuit
item.description: Utah's attorney general has filed notices to reassign four cases dealing with abortion, redistricting, Great Salt Lake and fossil fuels to a new "constitutional court."

item.title: Red Butte Garden announces lineup for second show for 2026 Outdoor Concert Series
item.description: KALEO is the second headliner booked for this year's Red Butte Garden Summer concert series.

item.title: Utah County prosecutors have ‘no significant’ bias in pursuing case against Charlie Kirk’s accused killer, judge rules
item.description: Tyler James Robinson's defense team had been trying to get the Utah County attorney's office removed from the case after learning a prosecutor's daughter was at the Utah Valley University event where Charlie Kirk was shot.

item.title: Gunman fires multiple shots at prominent Utah Muslim leader
item.description: A gunman waited at Imam Shuaib Din's home and then took multiple shots at him as he left his garage to return to Utah's largest mosque.
